name: Pgadmin
description: pgAdmin is a web-based database management tool for administering your PostgreSQL databases through a user-friendly interface.
composeYaml:
services:
  pgadmin:
    image: 'dpage/pgadmin4:latest'
    environment:
      - 'PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL=${PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL:?}'
      - 'PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=${PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD:?}'
    volumes:
      - 'pgadmin-data:/var/lib/pgadmin'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '-qO-'
        - 'http://localhost:80/login'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
